name: cascade_delete
description: In `app.delete('/api/customers/:c_custkey')`, the code explicitly deletes all `Order` rows with `Order.destroy({ where: { o_custkey } })` before deleting the customer. However, the `GET /api/orders` endpoint only returns orders tied to active customers (via `required: true` inner join), so no other endpoint needs orphaned orders to exist after parent deletion. This means there is no observable data loss for another endpoint.
